_comment: ADR-037 register fragment — public-forms-runtime. Adds the `ShareToken` schema to the shared `openbuild` register: a token names exactly one Application + one page (D1 of design.md), never a whole Application. Per ADR-022 this is the OR-backed model for OpenBuild's first #[PublicPage] surface — no bespoke DB table. `mode: submit` (optional boundObjectId → prefill only) and `mode: edit` + `boundObjectId` (D4) share the same schema/resolution path; `mode: read` is a public read-only page share. The `token` value itself is the opaque addressing handle (mirrors OpenRegister's CaseToken precedent — looked up directly, not hashed); `passwordHash` is the only hashed-at-rest field. Creation is gated server-side by `ShareTokenService::issue()` requiring the target page's manifest `config.public.enabled` to be `true` (REQ in specs/public-form-access/spec.md) — the schema itself does not (and cannot) see the manifest.

ShareToken.title: Share Token
ShareToken.description: An opaque, cryptographically random public-access token scoping anonymous render/submit access to exactly one Application + one page (public-form-access, design.md D1). Never exported inside a manifest blob — environment-specific secret, not portable app config.

applicationId.title: Application UUID
applicationId.description: UUID of the Application this token is scoped to. A token never exposes any page/schema outside this Application.

pageId.title: Page ID
pageId.description: The bound page's manifest `page.id` (vue-router route name) within the Application's production manifest. A token resolves to this page only.

token.title: Token
token.description: Server-generated, opaque, cryptographically random (>=256 bits) URL-safe token — the public addressing handle. Never derived from or containing the applicationId/pageId.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: `submit` = anonymous create-form (optionally prefilled from allow-listed query params). `read` = public read-only page, no write path. `edit` = per-record edit link, requires `boundObjectId` and a mandatory `expiresAt`.

boundObjectId.title: Bound Object UUID
boundObjectId.description: Optional. When set (required for `mode: edit`), the form is pre-filled from this object's current values and submission updates this object instead of creating a new one.

expiresAt.title: Expires At
expiresAt.description: Optional for `submit`/`read`; MANDATORY for `mode: edit` (enforced by ShareTokenService::issue(), default short window e.g. 30 days). A resolve after this timestamp fails closed.

passwordHash.title: Password Hash
passwordHash.description: Optional. When set, the public render/submit endpoints require the matching plaintext password before resolving. Hashed at rest (never the plaintext) — the only hashed field on this schema.

revoked.title: Revoked
revoked.description: Manual revoke flag. Takes effect immediately for subsequent resolves — a revoked token never resolves again, regardless of expiry.

allowedPrefillFields.title: Allowed Prefill Fields
allowedPrefillFields.description: Allow-list of form field keys that MAY be prefilled from public render query parameters (`?<key>=<value>`). Any query parameter not in this list is ignored and never reflected into the form or the eventual submission.

honeypotField.title: Honeypot Field Name
honeypotField.description: Server-generated, randomised per-token field name rendered as a visually-hidden input. A non-empty value on submit silently no-ops the write (200, no object created/updated) — never a static, greppable constant.

requireEmailVerification.title: Require Email Verification
requireEmailVerification.description: Accept-then-flag (design.md Open Questions): when true, a successful anonymous submission still writes immediately but the created/updated object also carries `emailVerified: false` for the owner to filter on. Does not block the write.
